target.title: fix(diagnostics): avoid queue depth for accepted embedded steering
target.body:
## Summary

- Keep diagnostic `message.queued` events for accepted active embedded-run steering without counting them as queued backlog.
- Apply the non-backlog accounting only to active embedded-run steering; reply-run fallback and normal queued messages still increment `queueDepth`.
- Add a regression test proving an active embedded run can accept steering, finish, and leave diagnostic `queueDepth` at zero.

## What Problem This Solves

Active embedded runs can accept steered messages immediately through their run handle. That path was still logged as queued backlog, incrementing diagnostic `queueDepth`.

When the active run later completed, the normal idle transition only decremented one queue slot, so diagnostics could still report positive `queueDepth` even though no queued work remained.

Fixes #98685

## Evidence

- The new regression test queues a message into an active embedded run, verifies the handle receives it, clears the run, and asserts diagnostic state is idle with `queueDepth === 0`.
- Normal queued-message accounting is preserved because `logMessageQueued` still increments `queueDepth` by default; only accepted active embedded-run steering passes `countAsQueueDepth: false`.
- Runtime proof against real registry/diagnostic modules on the refreshed branch:

```text
$ node --import tsx - <<'SCRIPT'
# imports real src/infra/diagnostic-events.ts,
# src/logging/diagnostic-session-state.ts, and
# src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.ts
# then registers one active embedded run, queues two steering messages,
# clears the run, and prints diagnostic state.
SCRIPT
before steer queueDepth=0 state=processing activeQueuedTurn=false
steer outcomes queued=true,target=embedded_run; queued=true,target=embedded_run
queued messages: continue one, continue two, steeringMode=all
after accepted active steering queueDepth=0 state=processing activeQueuedTurn=false
after clearActiveEmbeddedRun queueDepth=0 state=idle activeQueuedTurn=false
```

- Local focused suites passed after resolving the branch conflict with current `main`:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/diagnostic.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.test.ts`
    - 2 Vitest shards passed: `diagnostic.test.ts` 72 tests, `runs.test.ts` 30 tests.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.runtime.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.integration.test.ts src/logging/message-lifecycle.test.ts`
    - 1 Vitest shard passed: 3 files, 31 tests.
  - `git diff --check`

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/diagnostic.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.runtime.test.ts src/logging/diagnostic-stuck-session-recovery.integration.test.ts src/logging/message-lifecycle.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
